card.name: Louisiana Purchase and scattered history words
card.fires_on: Strongest on the word Louisiana (and Purchase) in the phrase Louisiana Purchase, in US history text. Elsewhere it fires weakly on scattered words with no shared theme.

modes.label: Louisiana Purchase
modes.description: Fires on Louisiana or Purchase when the phrase refers to the 1803 land deal.
modes.example: Called the<< Louisiana>> Purchase, this transaction added 83

modes.label: Scattered other words
modes.description: Weak firing on unrelated words in the middle of a phrase, such as a place name, a comma or a word piece.
modes.example: Louisiana is ceded to<< Spain>> by France.

card.plain: It mainly spots the phrase Louisiana Purchase in history writing, and otherwise fires on mixed unrelated words.
